risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Support For Predictive Maintenance, the organization's understanding of the threat environment may become stale, leaving defenses misaligned with active adversary tactics. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Change Management Program
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of a change management program.
compensating_control_1.justification: Change Management Program (CHG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Automated Support For Predictive Maintenance (MNT-10.1) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Timely Maintenance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to obtain maintenance support and/or spare parts for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) within a defined Recovery Time Objective (RTO).
compensating_control_2.justification: Timely Maintenance (MNT-04) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Automated Support For Predictive Maintenance (MNT-10.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
